items.description: Array of list items. A string renders a simple item. Objects can include content and children for nested lists of any depth; optional ordered/unstyled/className customize nested lists.

caption.description: Optional label rendered in a figcaption before the list. Wraps the list in a figure when provided.

ordered.description: Render an ordered list using an ol element.

unstyled.description: Remove default list styling with usa-list--unstyled.
